_about: ITEM 4 (2026-11-19). WRITTEN by app/src/components/chart/engine/ast/htfTwoStarts.test.js (HTF_TWO_STARTS_WRITE=1), READ by it and by tests/test_pine_htf_two_starts.py. `bars`: the cut chart (a seeded random walk; its first bar, Wednesday 2024-01-03, opens a partial week); `chart`: the lane facts handed to interpret. `served`: the evaluator's column on `bars`; `bound`: the same with the two-start ceiling at 1 step (B is never run: a running value is withheld from its first unknown bar on). The Python lane (ast_interpret.interpret, newest_bar_is_forming false; TWO_START_CEILING[0] = 1 for `bound`) must equal both.

cases.name: ema(tf_merge(W, high), 3) (a running value over a partial-week site)
ema(nz(tf_merge(W, high)), 3) (through nz: the running value's own input starts later)
tf_live(W, ema(high, 3)) (a running value inside the read: the child's two starts)
ema(nz(close[1]), 3) (a running value carrying a read before the chart)
ema(nz(close[1]), 3) + nz(tf_live(W, nz(close[1]))) (one node read on the chart and inside a read)
